verification.note: Publisher pages read for each cited section: §7.6 gives the H–O–H angle in water as 104.5°, all angles in methane as 109.5°, CO₂ as linear (180°), and H–N–H in ammonia as slightly smaller than the 109.5° tetrahedral angle; §3.3 defines molarity as moles of solute per liter of solution and gives the dilution equation C₁V₁ = C₂V₂; §14.2 defines pH = −log[H₃O⁺] and gives [H₃O⁺] = 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ M and pH 7.00 for pure water at 25 °C.
